title: Priority change priority-change.kp.radical-endpoint-paint-continuity-v1
summary: The generic paint-space and font-continuity repair is implemented and fully verified. Source and target endpoint jumps, literal one-half font substitution, atomic empty-frame fallback, and cross-host WebGL lifecycle now have durable regression gates. Human visual confirmation remains before slice 17 or library expansion.
